title: arifOS Federation Unknowns Schema
description: Every unknown must be a declared object. Unknowns are not shame. Unknowns are control points. This schema enforces the shape; the unknowns file (unknowns.json) is the runtime registry.
doctrine: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — Unknowns declared, not hidden. Invariant I10 of the 13 Core Invariants.

session_id.description: Session that last updated this registry.

unknowns.description: Declared unknowns. Each unknown has id, question, risk, test, owner, verdict.

id.description: Unique identifier for this unknown. Format: U1, U2, U3, ...

question.description: What is not known? State the question precisely.

risk.description: If the unknown is left unresolved, what could go wrong? Floor impact (F1-F13).

test.description: Concrete test or command that would resolve this unknown. Reproducible by any agent.

owner.description: Who is responsible for resolving this unknown?

verdict.description: Current status. OPEN = not yet addressed. RESOLVED = test confirmed. ACCEPTED = owner has decided to live with it (documented). HOLD = blocked until something else happens.

resolution_evidence.description: Verbatim output of the test, or pointer to it.

floor_impact.description: Which floors are affected if this unknown is missed.

invariants_at_risk.description: Which of the 13 invariants are at risk if this unknown is missed.

references.description: URLs, file paths, or refs to related evidence.

unknowns.question: Does /canon/*.md serve static markdown or SPA fallback shell?
unknowns.risk: AI agents cannot retrieve authoritative Atlas if SPA fallback intercepts. I7 violated. Canon becomes unreachable.
unknowns.test: curl -s https://arif-fazil.com/canon/WEB_ATLAS.md | head -3 && echo '---END---' && curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' https://arif-fazil.com/canon/WEB_ATLAS.md

unknowns.question: Is the /arif sovereign path actually bare (no fractal pattern)?
unknowns.risk: SOVEREIGN_BARE invariant violated. Sovereign becomes decorated, which is the opposite of the law.
unknowns.acceptance_rationale: Sovereign verified visually and via curl. /arif is bare. False positive in lint rule (template.json has 'surface-page' which is fine).

unknowns.question: Which routes are shadowed by SPA fallback?
unknowns.risk: Static evidence routes (/canon/*, /999/*, .well-known/*, llms.txt) might be swallowed by SPA shell. I7 violated.
unknowns.test: for p in /canon/WEB_ATLAS.md /999 /llms.txt /sitemap.xml /.well-known/agent-card.json; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p = %{http_code}\n" "https://arif-fazil.com$p"; done

rules.name: every_unknown_has_id
rules.rule: Each unknown has a unique id matching ^U[0-9]+$

rules.name: every_unknown_has_test
rules.rule: Each unknown has a concrete, reproducible test (command or query)

rules.name: every_unknown_has_owner
rules.rule: Each unknown has an owner enum: agent, operator, sovereign, coder, auditor

rules.name: verdict_required
rules.rule: Each unknown has a verdict: OPEN, RESOLVED, ACCEPTED, HOLD

rules.name: accepted_rationale_required
rules.rule: If verdict=ACCEPTED, acceptance_rationale and accepted_by are required

rules.name: floor_impact_required
rules.rule: Each unknown has at least one floor_impact (F1-F13)

rules.name: invariants_at_risk_required
rules.rule: Each unknown has at least one invariants_at_risk (I1-I13)

maintenance.owner: sovereign (F13) for ACCEPTED; agent for OPEN/HOLD
maintenance.lifecycle: OPEN → RESOLVED (test passed) OR ACCEPTED (owner decided to live with it, documented) OR HOLD (blocked)
maintenance.promotion: OPEN that is ACCEPTED in 90 days → ESCALATE to sovereign for review

tenant_contract.signature: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — Unknowns declared, not hidden. I10.
